title: Sports Club News
description: Four recordings about a local sports club: a radio report, two friends, a phone message and a coach's speech.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Radio sports news
parts.intro: You will hear a radio presenter giving local sports news.

script.speaker: Mark
script.text: Good evening and welcome to Local Sports Round-up. With me today is Anna from Riverside Sports Club.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Hello, Mark. We have some good news this week. Our girls' basketball team won the final on Saturday.

script.speaker: Mark
script.text: Congratulations! What was the score?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Forty-two to thirty-eight. It was a very close game. Our best player, Hoa, scored twenty points.

script.speaker: Mark
script.text: Wonderful. And I hear the club has a new swimming teacher.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, his name is Mr Cooper. He used to teach in Australia, and the children already love him. Lessons start on Tuesday evenings at six o'clock.

script.speaker: Mark
script.text: Is the pool open to everyone?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, but you must become a member first. The price is ten pounds a month for adults and five for children.

script.speaker: Mark
script.text: That's a good price. Thanks, Anna, and good luck with the next match.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Thank you, Mark. See you all at the pool!

parts.title: Part 2 · Two friends
parts.intro: You will hear Tuan and Linh talking about joining a sports club.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: Hi, Linh. I'm thinking about joining the sports club. Do you go there?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, I go every Wednesday and Friday. I play tennis. Which sport do you like?

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: I like running, but I'm not very fast. I'd like to try badminton, too.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Then come on Friday. There's a beginners' badminton class at four o'clock. It's really fun.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: Do I need my own racket?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, the club has some. But bring your own shoes, because the floor is slippery.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: Good. Is it expensive?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Not really. The first class is free, and after that it's three pounds each time.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: That's cheap! Maybe I'll ask my brother, too. He's very tall, so he'd be good at it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Great idea. Meet me outside the main door at ten to four.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear a voicemail message from the club secretary.

script.speaker: Karen
script.text: Hello, this is Karen from Riverside Sports Club. I am calling all football parents with some important news.

script.speaker: Karen
script.text: The match on Saturday is moved from ten o'clock to eleven, because the field is too wet. We will play at the school field instead of the club.

script.speaker: Karen
script.text: Please remember that each child needs a green shirt. If you do not have one, you can borrow one from the coach.

script.speaker: Karen
script.text: We also need two parents to help with drinks. If you can help, please call me back. It's not difficult, and you can watch the match.

script.speaker: Karen
script.text: Finally, after the match, the club will give a prize to the player of the year. It's a surprise, so please don't tell the children. Thank you, and see you on Saturday!

parts.title: Part 4 · The coach's speech
parts.intro: You will hear a coach talking to his team after a match.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Well, boys and girls, we lost today, three to one. I know you're sad, but I want to say something.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: First, I'm proud of you. You ran hard for the whole game, even when it started to rain. That's what a team does.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Second, we made some mistakes, but that's normal. Everybody makes mistakes. What's important is to learn from them.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Our goalkeeper played very well. Without Minh, we'd have lost by seven or eight goals!

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Next week, we play the best team in the league. Nobody expects us to win, so we have nothing to lose. Let's have fun.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Now, go and get changed. And don't forget to say thank you to the other team. It's good manners. See you on Thursday at training!
